# Final Implementation Plan

## Wave A — Close retention core
- Confirm all pending product-memory writes are present.
- Run structural and pure behavior tests.
- Fix only proven defects with whole-file rewrites.

## Wave B — Global integration
- Record product visits from the universal foundation.
- Mount favorite control in the universal commerce footer.
- Apply recent-first ordering and Recent/Favorite badges to Apps.
- Apply equivalent ordering/decoration to Games through its existing projection/view boundaries.
- Refresh catalog decoration on the shared product-memory change event where relevant.

## Wave C — Full verification
- Run the complete green release baseline plus memory tests.
- Production-faithful mobile and desktop browser proof.
- Verify launcher, Radiance, favorite control, recents/favorites, keyboard state, and return context.

## Wave D — Reliability and economy
- Run isolated full-server startup timing using a temporary DB root.
- Measure and address the dominant safe startup bottleneck if evidence permits.
- Audit wallet reconciliation/reservation health and add operator-facing health/testimony if missing.

## Wave E — Workflow and product value
- Trace existing share/export/import/open-with patterns.
- Implement one reusable cross-product handoff primitive if missing.
- Identify fulfillment-backed premium opportunities and implement only those supported by real handlers.

## Wave F — Final audit
- Re-read every touched file.
- Compare original plans to actual implementation.
- Run final tests/browser proof.
- Write remaining-work and next-action ledgers for anything not honestly complete.
